snippet.title: Golf With Your Friends 2 - Official Trailer | ID@Xbox April 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Watch the trailer for Golf With Your Friends 2 to see courses and more from this upcoming sequel to the sports game. Tee off in Golf With Your Friends 2! Dive into 12-player chaos, wild new Chaos Mode, a revamped level editor, and more. 
Golf With Your Friends 2 will be available on Xbox Series X/S in fall 2026. It is also coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and PC.
